events.title: VIP Demo Experience with Reveleer
events.location: Reveleer Booth 306, Hyatt Regency Chicago, 151 E Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60601
events.description:
VIP Demo Experience with Reveleer

In your 20-minute session, we'll show you firsthand how Reveleer connects CDI, risk adjustment, and care gap workflows on a shared clinical data foundation - and what that means for your programs.

Where: Reveleer Booth 306 - ACDIS Annual Conference
Hyatt Regency Chicago
151 E Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60601

Exclusive VIP Gift: Participants will enjoy designing a custom trucker hat as part of their demo experience.

*Exclusively for health plans, health system/hospitals, and healthcare physician/clinician professionals only. No vendors.

Questions? Email events@reveleer.com

In your 30-minute session, we'll walk through how one platform aligns risk adjustment and quality programs to support Stars performance, reducing vendor complexity and operational overhead.

Where: Meeting Room Doolittle · Medicare Stars, HEDIS, Quality & Risk Summit
Hilton Rosemont/Chicago O'Hare
5550 N River Rd, Rosemont, IL 60018

Exclusive meeting gift: Participate in a demo and receive an exclusive film-inspired digital camera to capture key conference moments.

*Exclusively for health plans, health system/hospitals, and healthcare physician/clinician professionals only. No vendors.

Want to bring a colleague? Email events@reveleer.com to add them.

Questions? Email events@reveleer.com

events.title: Networking Dinner at Three Three Seven
events.location: Three Three Seven, 629 J Street, San Diego, CA 92101
events.description:
Thank you for RSVPing to our networking dinner at Three Three Seven.

Chef Jay Fernell will guide you through eleven courses that trace his path from Carencro, Louisiana, to the seafood and farms of Southern California. The table is small, ten seats total, so come ready for a slower, closer evening than the usual conference dinner.

If you are departing from the Manchester Grand Hyatt, we will meet in the lobby at 5:30 pm to walk over as a group (about a 15 min walk).

Questions? Email events@reveleer.com
